title: Spider Eye Basket
description: Too many spider eyes clogging up your inventory? Put it in a basket! Acts to both as a storage solution and decorative item.
body:
Ever get tired of spider eye clogging up your inventory? Worry no longer, with the all new Spider Eye Basket. A convient storage solution with the added benefit of a nice decorative block. 

Create Delight is a terrific mod but lacks a way to condense spider eyes.
